accepted_claim: Complete conversion O(N [L^2 log(L+1)]^(log2(3)-1)) under the inherited array-bit model, actual heights O(m), and sufficiently wide ambient supplied parameters. Includes every setup, diagonal, narrow packed product, modular division, carry, grouping and output charge.
little_o_example: L=O((log N)^(4/5)), N=Lm, supplied admissible parameters and paid parameter encoding.
mandatory_qualifications: Actual W may be below t on small-valued inputs. The standalone simplified shift theorem requires W>=t; full conversion uses padding or the unsimplified ledger with W<=Cm, m>=t, q<=1+W/t=O(m/t).
An unrestricted externally encoded grouping parameter d adds O(bitlength(d)) reading/comparison cost. The main N-only bound assumes this cost is absorbed, for example d<=L or bitlength(d)=O(N).
